confidence is required (0 to 1) for the batch.

gaps.gap_description: No independent monitor on GitHub API / githubstatus.com; GitHub 5xx is only detected after the site-heartbeat job itself fails consecutive runs.
gaps.evidence: Alert title is 'Scheduled job failed 2 runs in a row: injected 503 (github) (game day: github_5xx)'. CI-SITE-003 (github-api) lists status_page https://www.githubstatus.com but the firing signal is only the heartbeat consecutive-failure path, not a direct external-dependency health check.
gaps.suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change: Add a lightweight monitor that polls GitHub status (githubstatus.com component or API health) on a shorter interval than the 10-minute cron and opens a Low/Medium alert on elevated 5xx so Reliability is notified before two heartbeat failures accumulate.

gaps.gap_description: Heartbeat alert waits for two consecutive missed runs (~20 minutes) while the outside probe only pages after 35 minutes stale, delaying detection of known external 5xx.
gaps.evidence: Title states failed 2 runs in a row; CI-SITE-002 details say schedule every 10 minutes, 'The snapshot absorbs two missed runs; the outside probe pages after 35 minutes stale,' and runbook_hint already classifies GitHub 5xx as external dependency.
gaps.suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change: For heartbeat failures whose error class is GitHub 5xx/timeout, emit an alert on the first failed run (do not wait for the two-run absorb window) and keep the two-run threshold only for unknown/non-classified errors.

gaps.gap_description: Runbook guidance to check githubstatus.com on GitHub 5xx exists only as a CMDB runbook_hint on the job CI and is not auto-attached to the firing alert during triage.
gaps.evidence: CI-SITE-002 details include runbook_hint 'GitHub 5xx or timeouts on this job = external dependency: check githubstatus.com before suspecting a regression' while incident state is TRIAGING with routing to Reliability and no indication an actionable runbook was linked on the alert.
gaps.suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change: Bind the site-heartbeat consecutive-failure alert to a short runbook step that auto-surfaces when the failure reason contains GitHub 5xx: open githubstatus.com, confirm external 5xx, and suppress app-regression investigation unless status is green.
